headline: GitHub's Copilot command-line tool can now find AI models that a developer runs on their own computer.
score_reason: Pool 6 kept: a useful developer change with no overstated claim.
importance_line: Developers who use GitHub's Copilot tool can pick a model that runs on their own machine without leaving their workflow, but the model and its helper program must already be installed, and choosing a local model does not switch on offline mode or stop usage data going to GitHub.
summary: GitHub says that from version 1.0.94-0 of its Copilot command-line tool, the model menu lists models from a running local Ollama instance, which is a program for running AI models on a computer. A developer still has to choose a model and confirm it, and GitHub notes that offline mode remains a separate choice.
notes: Read in full (GitHub changelog, GitHub's own announcement, so GitHub is the first reporter). GitHub also announces intelligent routing with local models, with availability to follow; not included.
